Volunteer Registration

Become a Volunteer

Join 3,200+ active volunteers. Whether you have a few hours or a full commitment, there is a role for you.

Why Volunteer With Us?

  • 🌱
    Meaningful Impact

    See direct, tangible results in the communities you serve — not abstract metrics.

  • 🤝
    Global Network

    Join 3,200+ volunteers across 18 countries united by faith and compassion.

  • 📚
    Grow Your Skills

    Gain real experience in development, leadership, and cross-cultural service.

  • ✈️
    Travel & Serve

    International placements available — serve locally or abroad.

  • 💛
    A Family Community

    Every volunteer is welcomed as family. You will never serve alone.
